title: Chicken Enchiladas (Flour Tortilla Style)
ingredients: Shredded chicken (shredded in a stand mixer in the video)
Flour tortillas (used in place of traditional corn tortillas)
Enchilada sauce (appears red, exact type not confirmed)
instructions: Shred cooked chicken (shown being shredded in a stand mixer).
Wrap chicken and cream cheese in flour tortillas, rolling into enchiladas.
Place rolled tortillas in a baking dish.
Top with enchilada sauce and shredded cheese.
Bake until cheese is melted and bubbly (exact temp/time not shown/stated).
notes: PARTIAL — VIDEO ONLY. The Facebook Reel (by creator Valerie Rogers, caption 'My definition of authentic') did not have a written recipe in the caption or top comments — comments were mostly reactions/banter, not instructions. Steps above are inferred from watching the video frames (chicken shredded in a stand mixer, cream cheese, flour tortillas rolled and placed in a pan, sauce and cheese visible). Multiple commenters noted it's unusual to use flour tortillas for enchiladas rather than corn. One commenter (Norma Adams) shared her own version using red enchilada sauce, cream cheese, taco seasoning, and roasted fire-roasted tomatoes — that is her personal variation, not confirmed as Valerie's exact recipe, but could be a useful reference if recreating this.
